scope: Public callback ordering and source portability only; no device adapter or physical trial acceptance
verified_policies: One execute call per instance, including after failure
Unknown transfer ownership/status forbids BOOT and recovery
Only a nonzero known terminal timeout permits pre-BOOT reset
Readback mismatch with successful transfer cannot reset
Live observers and durable intent precede one BOOT callback
Failed observer stop prevents pre-BOOT recovery
No BOOT/reset/reboot retry after the intent barrier
Intent/report/observation errors and interrupts still attempt native verification
Failed native verification cannot return success
limitations: Actual adapter bindings, durable ownership and process reaping remain separate requirements.
The frozen prepared controller retains its original generic-flow snapshot and outer guards.
Callback tests establish no physical RFSA, USB, independent return, firmware or modem/GNSS pass.
